commit.message:
test: restore village capture platform before framework invariants

The six actual village captures reached their final assertions in run 43584973927 but failed Flutter's post-body debug invariants because addTearDown restored the platform override too late. Restore it in a body-level finally while preserving every layout, capture and launch assertion.

Route only repair/lumo-single-apk-20261114 away from the older generic workflow; the canonical C4 workflow retains all build, runtime and update gates. The exact branch exclusion and unrelated-branch controls passed independently. The local capture retry aborted in the compiler before tests; the fresh canonical CI run must verify all six cases.
